## Checklist

- [ ] Related brief is linked or included.
- [ ] Reuse / dependency / skills decision is documented.
- [ ] Tests or validation checks were run and results are noted.
- [ ] UI / UX impact is addressed, if applicable.
- [ ] Logging / observability impact is addressed.
- [ ] Post-launch validation is defined, if deployed.
- [ ] Scope is limited to the approved change.
- [ ] Risk and rollback notes are included.
- [ ] Security / privacy impact is considered.
